messages:
Rafael (AE): Heads-up from BlueHarbor POC: they need a compact SOC2 excerpt, ISO residency blurb for EU backups, a signed pen-test attestation, and answers to a 6-question security questionnaire. Also asked if a short dedicated-node trial would change POC pricing. Can we do all this next week?
June (Solutions Eng): I can pull SOC2 + ISO snippets and draft answers to the questionnaire. For dedicated-node pricing we'll need to quote reserved capacity; I can give a ballpark.
Omar (Security): For the questionnaire we should be careful with answers around key management and logging. We'll refuse to share raw audit logs or KMS material. For pen-test attestation we need signer name + reg id and whether they require GDPR language.
Rafael (AE): BlueHarbor contact: security@blueharbor.io. They requested an unauthenticated external scan on staging next Thu 09:30 CET for 30 mins. Source IPs: 52.210.11.22. UA: "BlueProbe/2.0". They also want DPO confirmation on the GDPR clause.
Kai (Infra): /32s OK. Please give CIDRs and exact open/close times. Rate estimate please so we can avoid autoscale alarms.
June (Solutions Eng): I'll create a small evidence bundle (SOC2 excerpt + ISO EU backup note + questionnaire answers) and upload to presigned S3. Will exclude any KMS artifacts. Expected scan rate: low (~12 r/s).
Omar (Security): We'll redact internal ticket links and production hostnames. DPO/GDPR language: Legal should include standard processing clause; confirm with BlueHarbor if they need an alternate formulation.
Rafael (AE): Filling LegalBot fields for attestation: signer_name: Ingrid Svensson; signer_title: Head of Security; company_name: BlueHarbor Financial; registration_id: SE-55667788; testing_scope: unauthenticated external scan of staging hostnames only; desired_return_email: security@blueharbor.io
LegalBot: Received fields. Also request whether BlueHarbor requires a bespoke indemnity clause or proof of cyber insurance. Reply with yes/no. Once confirmed we'll draft signed attestation within 48 hours.
Rafael (AE): BlueHarbor says no bespoke indemnity, insurance proof not required.
June (Solutions Eng): Uploaded presigned evidence bundle (24h expiry): https://s3-us-west-2.amazonaws.com/redwood-evidence-temp/blueharbor/evidence.zip?X-Amz-Expires=86400
Kai (Infra): Scheduling firewall change: open 52.210.11.22/32 at Thu 09:20 CET, close at 10:00 CET. Adding monitoring and auto-rollback on anomalous traffic >100 r/s.
Omar (Security): I'll review uploaded bundle and flag redactions. LegalBot, please add GDPR processing language and include non-destructive testing clause in attestation.
LegalBot: Noted. Drafting attestation with GDPR clause and non-destructive testing language; expected signed PDF within 48 hours after security confirms redactions.
Rafael (AE): Also looping procurement: June, can you post a two-week dedicated-node estimate here for BlueHarbor so they can decide?
June (Solutions Eng): Will post a high-level 2-week reserved capacity estimate by EOD.
Rafael (AE): Great, passing to BlueHarbor: security@blueharbor.io. I will update thread when signed attestation is ready or if anything blocks. :thumbsup:
